```sql
with scoped_attempts as (
    select
        a.status,
        a.failure_reason
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.region_id in ('IN-TN')
      and ci.name = 'Chennai'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-09-03' and date '2026-09-09'
),
denom as (
    select count(*) as total_attempts
    from scoped_attempts
)
select
    sa.failure_reason as key,
    cast(count(*) * 1.0 / nullif(d.total_attempts, 0) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from scoped_attempts sa
cross join denom d
where sa.status = 'failed'
  and sa.failure_reason is not null
group by sa.failure_reason, d.total_attempts
order by value desc, key asc
```
